record.content: ROG 16-41 November 2018 p3 lists Cooper Meadow as three miles and identifies Coyote Meadow Trailhead as the start. The Day Hikes introduction on p2 specifies one-way mileages. The precise meadow endpoint is unresolved; this is a destination report, not an atomic segment distance.
record.observer: Wayproof primary-source text, geospatial map and named-feature review
